recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If the obsolete-looking QUICK model-definition example should be modernized, review it separately under Clinical Reasoning/Library rather than as a FHIR-5860 Bundle resource rename.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core Feed issue asking to rename Bundle entry Transaction and TransactionResponse components to Interaction and InteractionResponse because transaction entries are individual REST interactions; the Jira resolution says it was resolved under FHIR-6122.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-5860 was found. The FHIR-6122 implementation commit 5a81d5df0f added batch/batch-response support and renamed Bundle.entry.transaction and Bundle.entry.transactionResponse to Bundle.entry.request and Bundle.entry.response in Bundle and HTTP source; 078364522c fixed remaining renamed Bundle narrative references.
additional_context: FHIR-6122 is Published/Persuasive with Modification and chose request/response as the final replacement names, not Interaction/InteractionResponse. Bundle is active in source/fhir.ini; current StructureDefinition, Bundle notes, examples, and REST transaction/batch narrative use request/response. A source search found the old transactionResponse name only inside a QUICK model-definition Library example, not in the authoritative Bundle resource definition, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting later record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current built Bundle source already reflects the modified FHIR-6122 decision that disposed of FHIR-5860, and changing to Interaction/InteractionResponse would contradict the applied issue-family decision.

related_jiras.note: Broader batch/non-atomic transaction issue whose published resolution handled FHIR-5860 by choosing request/response as the replacement element names.
